wiki.title: Bill G. Schuette
wiki.extract: William "Bill" Grebe Schuette (/ˈʃuːti/ SHOO-tee; born July 21, 1995) is an American politician and former intelligence analyst for the Defense Intelligence Agency from 2018 to 2021 who is currently representing Michigan's 95th district in the Michigan House of Representatives. He is the son of former Michigan Attorney General Bill Schuette.
